title: SMART Guidelines AI-ready package registry
description: Shape of registry.json, the generated index an agent loads first, and of the role, capability and requirement files it is built from.

repository.description: Repository this package ships in, as owner/name.

generatedFrom.description: Commit SHA the index was generated from. Informational; staleness is detected by regenerating and comparing.

conformance.description: RFC 2119 strength, matching the FHIR R5 Requirements resource.

role.description: An actor. Experts are roles with meta.expert set; they inherit from the WHO SMART Guidelines authoring personas rather than replacing them.

inherits.description: Role ids this role inherits capabilities from. The graph across all roles must be acyclic.

capabilities.description: Capability ids granted directly, in addition to those inherited. These are tools and access rights that can be detected at runtime, and every entry must resolve to a file in registry/capabilities.

permissions.description: Authority this role carries that no runtime probe can detect — approval-authority, clinical-validation, release-authorization. Kept separate from capabilities because a capability check answers can this machine do it, and a permission answers may this person decide it. Conflating them makes the first check unreliable and the second meaningless.

smartBaseAnalog.description: The corresponding SGAuthoring.Persona.* actor in smart-base, where one exists.

skills.description: Path to the skill tree this expert bundles.

capability.description: A tool or permission a skill may require, with a way to detect whether it is present.

requires.description: Capability ids this one depends on.

requirement.description: A set of conformance statements, mirroring the FHIR R5 Requirements resource so the governance spec is itself a SMART Guidelines artifact.
Full statement text. Where the statement comes from an SOP page, the SOP's own wording and strength are preserved.

actors.description: Narrows the parent requirement's actors for this statement only.

dependsOn.description: Keys of statements in the same requirement that must hold first.

expert.description: Index entry for an expert bundle. The prose lives in experts/<id>/EXPERT.md.

role.description: Role id this expert acts as.

skillIndexEntry.description: Index entry generated from a SKILL.md frontmatter block. Carries enough to route without reading the body.

sop.description: The standard operating procedure page holding this skill's procedure. The SOP is the single source of truth for narrative; the skill carries the contract around it.

status.description: Describes the contract, not the narrative. specified: schemas constrain real structure and a requirement file carries the definition of done. placeholder: schemas permit anything and no requirement file exists yet.
